meals.title: 1, 2, 3 Chicken
meals.description: Skillet chicken simmered with salsa and black beans, then smothered in melted cheese.

walmart.name: Freshness Guaranteed Thin-Sliced Chicken Breasts, 0.8-3.5 lb
Pace Chunky Medium Salsa, 16 oz
Great Value Black Beans, 15 oz
Great Value Finely Shredded Colby Jack, 8 oz

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 4 small chicken breasts (or 6–8 chicken tenders)
- 1 jar (16 oz) salsa
- 1 can black beans
- 1 cup shredded cheese

## Instructions
1. Cook the chicken in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, 4 minutes per side.
2. Add the salsa and beans. Bring to a boil and cover.
3. Simmer on medium-low for 5 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 165°F.
4. Top with the cheese and remove from the heat. Let stand, covered, until the cheese melts.

## Tips
- Serve over potatoes, rice, or chips.

meals.title: Adam's Favorite Peanut Butter Cookies
meals.description: Sugar-rolled peanut butter cookies with a Hershey's Kiss in the middle.

walmart.name: Great Value Pure Granulated Sugar, 4 lb
Hershey's Kisses Milk Chocolate Family Pack, 17.9 oz

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 1 batch [Irresistible Peanut Butter Cookies](#irresistible-peanut-butter-cookies) dough
- Sugar, for rolling
- Hershey's Kisses (about 36)

## Instructions
1. Make a batch of Irresistible Peanut Butter Cookie dough.
2. Roll the dough into balls and roll them in sugar.
3. Bake as directed. When they come out of the oven, press a Hershey's Kiss into the center of each cookie.

## Notes
From "Cook Like Kathleen," Grandma Kathleen Moessing's family cookbook.

meals.title: Almond Bark

Baker's White Chocolate Baking Bar, 4 oz

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- Almonds
- Baker's white chocolate, melted

## Instructions
1. Spread the almonds over a jelly roll pan.
2. Pour the melted white chocolate over them.
3. Once cool, break into "bark."

## Notes
From "Cook Like Kathleen," Grandma Kathleen Moessing's family cookbook.

meals.title: Applesauce
meals.description: Open-kettle homemade applesauce, bottled.

walmart.name: Great Value Pure Granulated Sugar, 4 lb
Fresh Granny Smith Apples, 3 lb Bag

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- Apples
- About ½ cup sugar, to taste
- Water

## Instructions
1. Peel and slice the apples and add sugar to taste. Start with ½ cup; that's usually all she used.
2. Add water so the apples aren't completely covered, and watch so they don't burn. For thick sauce, don't add much water, but you need enough to cook the apples.
3. Cook until soft.
4. Pour into bottles and put on new, sterile lids and rings. Never put hot fruit in cold bottles.
5. Leave on the counter until they seal.

## Notes
These are Grandma's own instructions. For current tested canning methods, check the USDA or your local extension office.

From "Cook Like Kathleen," Grandma Kathleen Moessing's family cookbook.

meals.title: Baked Chicken
meals.description: Juicy chicken breasts seasoned with a Grill Mates packet and baked in 20 minutes.

walmart.name: Great Value Boneless Skinless Chicken Breasts, 3 lb (Frozen)
Grill Mates Garlic, Herb & Wine Marinade Mix, 0.87 oz

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- Chicken breasts (1 breast feeds 1–2 people)
- 1 packet McCormick Grill Mates seasoning

## Instructions
1. Preheat the oven to 450°F.
2. Season the chicken with the seasoning.
3. Line a shallow metal pan with foil (dull side up) for easier cleanup.
4. Bake 10 minutes, turn the chicken over, and bake 10 minutes more.

## Tips
- Serve with potatoes, rice, or noodles, in soft tacos, or sliced over a salad.

meals.title: Baked Chicken and Rice
meals.description: No-peek chicken and rice casserole baked in broth with cream of chicken soup.

walmart.name: Great Value Long Grain Rice, 5 lb
Great Value Chicken Breast Tenderloins, 3 lb (Frozen)
Campbell's Cream of Chicken Soup, 10.5 oz
Great Value Chicken Broth, 32 oz
Great Value Onion Soup & Dip Mix, 2 oz

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 2 cups uncooked rice
- 6 chicken tenders
- 1 can cream of chicken soup
- 4 cups chicken broth
- 1 package onion soup mix (or just salt and pepper)

## Instructions
1. Preheat the oven to 325°F.
2. Spray or butter the bottom of a 9x13 glass pan.
3. Spread the uncooked rice in the pan and add the broth.
4. Place the raw chicken on top and sprinkle with the soup mix (or salt and pepper).
5. Spread the cream of chicken soup over the top.
6. Bake uncovered for 1 hour, or until the broth is absorbed.

meals.title: Baked Italian Chicken Dinner
meals.description: Chicken, broccoli, and potatoes baked in one pan with butter and Italian dressing mix.

walmart.name: Freshness Guaranteed Thin-Sliced Chicken Breasts, 0.8-3.5 lb
Great Value Broccoli Florets, 12 oz (Frozen)
Russet Baking Potato, Each
Great Value Sweet Cream Salted Butter, 16 oz, 4 Sticks
Great Value Italian Dressing Mix, 0.7 oz

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 1 lb skinless, boneless chicken breast, cut into cubes
- 1 package (10 oz) frozen broccoli
- 4 potatoes, diced
- 1/4 cup butter, melted
- 1 package (0.7 oz) Italian dressing mix

## Instructions
1. Preheat the oven to 350°F. Spray a 13x9-inch baking dish with cooking spray.
2. Layer the chicken, broccoli, and potatoes evenly in the dish, in that order.
3. Drizzle the melted butter over the top and sprinkle with the Italian dressing mix.
4. Bake until the chicken is cooked through and the potatoes are tender, 45–60 minutes.

## Variations
- Try adding carrots.

meals.title: Baked Pesto Chicken
meals.description: Bite-size chicken baked in pesto and finished with melted mozzarella.

walmart.name: Great Value Boneless Skinless Chicken Breasts, 3 lb (Frozen)
Great Value Basil Pesto, 6.7 oz
Great Value Finely Shredded Mozzarella, 8 oz

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch pieces
- 1/4 cup pesto
- 1/4 cup mozzarella cheese
- Salt and pepper

## Instructions
1. Preheat the oven to 375°F.
2. Spray an 8x8 baking dish with non-stick spray. Spread 1/8 cup pesto over the bottom.
3. Spread the chicken over the pesto, then spread the remaining pesto over the chicken. (Don't re-dip a spoon that's touched raw chicken into the pesto.)
4. Cover with foil and bake 25–30 minutes.
5. Remove the foil, sprinkle the cheese on top, and bake uncovered 5 more minutes until melted.

## Tips
- Serve with rice, quinoa, or wide noodles, and spoon the pesto from the dish over the top.
- For a dairy-free portion, pull some chicken out before adding the cheese.

meals.title: Baked Potato
meals.description: Crispy-skinned oven baked potatoes, plus a quick microwave method.

walmart.name: Russet Baking Potato, Each
Great Value Extra Virgin Olive Oil, 17 fl oz
Hormel Chili with Beans, 15 oz

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- Potatoes (1 per person)
- Olive oil
- Sea or kosher salt
- 1 can Hormel chili with beans, for topping (optional)

## Instructions
1. Preheat the oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. Scrub the potatoes well and pat dry. Poke each one a few times with a fork.
3. Place on the baking sheet, rub all over with olive oil, and sprinkle generously with salt.
4. Bake 45–60 minutes, until the skins are crisp and puffy and a fork slides in easily.

## Tips
- **Microwave:** Wash the potatoes and poke them with a fork. Microwave 4 minutes, flip, then 4 minutes more.
- Top with warmed Hormel chili or [Grandma's Chili](#grandmas-chili) for a full meal.

meals.title: BBQ Chicken & Asparagus Fettuccine
meals.description: Grilled BBQ chicken tenders and asparagus over fettuccine in creamy Alfredo sauce.

walmart.name: Fresh Green Whole Asparagus Bunch
Great Value Alfredo Pasta Sauce, 16 oz

Barilla Fettuccine Pasta, 16 oz
Sweet Baby Ray's Original Barbecue Sauce, 18 oz
Great Value Vegetable Oil, 48 fl oz

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 1 1/2 lb chicken tenders
- 1 bunch asparagus, woody ends trimmed
- 12 oz fettuccine
- 1 jar (16 oz) Alfredo sauce
- 1/2 cup BBQ sauce
- 1 tbsp oil
- Salt and pepper to taste

## Instructions
1. Heat the grill to medium-high and start a large pot of salted water boiling.
2. Toss the chicken and asparagus with the oil, salt, and pepper.
3. Cook the fettuccine according to the package. Save 1/2 cup of the pasta water, then drain.
4. Grill the chicken 3–4 minutes per side, until done (165°F), brushing with the BBQ sauce for the last 2 minutes. Grill the asparagus 4–6 minutes, turning, until tender-crisp.
5. Warm the Alfredo sauce over low heat and toss with the fettuccine, loosening with pasta water as needed.
6. Cut the asparagus into bite-size pieces and slice the chicken. Serve over the pasta.

## Tips
- No grill? Use a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat.

meals.title: Bean Sprout and Spinach Salad
meals.description: Crisp spinach and bean sprouts with water chestnuts and a sesame-soy dressing.

walmart.name: Fresh Lemon, Each

Great Value Naturally Brewed Soy Sauce, 15 fl oz
Spice Islands Sesame Seed, 2.2 oz
Marketside Fresh Baby Spinach, 11 oz
Great Value Pure Granulated Sugar, 4 lb

meals.body:
## Ingredients
**Salad**
- 1 cup fresh bean sprouts (or 1 cup canned sprouts, drained)
- ½ lb fresh young spinach
- ½ cup thinly sliced water chestnuts

**Dressing**
- ½ cup sesame seed oil or peanut oil
- ¼ cup soy sauce
- 2 tbsp lemon juice
- 1 ½ tbsp grated onion
- 1 ½ tbsp sesame seeds, lightly toasted
- ½ tsp sugar
- ½ tsp pepper

## Instructions
1. Toast the sesame seeds in a moderate oven (350°F) for 10–12 minutes.
2. Make the dressing: combine the oil, soy sauce, lemon juice, onion, sesame seeds, sugar, and pepper. Let it stand 1 hour.
3. Pour boiling water over the fresh bean sprouts in a saucepan and heat over moderate heat without letting them boil. Drain, then soak in cold water until chilled. Drain and reserve. (Canned sprouts: soak in cold water for several hours and drain thoroughly.)
4. Wash the spinach in several changes of water. Cut off the stems, dry the leaves thoroughly, and chill.
5. Arrange the spinach in a salad bowl, top with the sprouts, then the water chestnuts. Pour the dressing over and toss thoroughly.

## Notes
From "Cook Like Kathleen," Grandma Kathleen Moessing's family cookbook.

- 1 cup diced onions
- 1 cup diced celery
- ¾ cup butter
- ¾ cup flour
- 1 quart half-and-half
- ½ tsp salt
- Dash pepper
- ½ tsp sugar
- 3 cans (6 ½ oz) clams
- 2 cans sliced potatoes, diced

1. Sauté the onions and celery in the butter until tender.

meals.title: BYU Mint Brownies
meals.description: The famous BYU campus brownie, with a mint icing layer and a chocolate icing top.

walmart.name: Great Value Sweet Cream Salted Butter, 16 oz, 4 Sticks
Great Value Unsweetened Cocoa Powder, 8 oz
Great Value Honey, 12 oz
Great Value White Large Eggs, 12 Count

Great Value Chopped Walnuts, 4 oz
Great Value Whole Vitamin D Milk, Gallon
Karo Light Corn Syrup, 16 oz
Great Value Powdered Sugar, 32 oz
McCormick Pure Peppermint Extract, 1 fl oz
Wilton Kelly Green Gel Food Coloring, 1 oz

meals.body:
## Ingredients
**Brownies**
- 1 cup butter or margarine
- 1/2 cup cocoa
- 2 tbsp honey
- 4 eggs
- 2 cups sugar
- 1 3/4 cups flour
- 1/2 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1 cup chopped walnuts

**Mint Icing**
- 5 tbsp butter or margarine
- Dash of salt
- 3 tbsp milk
- 1 tbsp light corn syrup
- 2 1/3 cups powdered sugar
- 1/2 tsp mint extract
- 1–2 drops green food coloring

**Chocolate Icing**
- 5 tbsp butter or margarine
- Dash of salt
- 3 tbsp milk
- 1 tbsp light corn syrup
- 2 1/3 cups powdered sugar
- 1/3 cup cocoa powder, sifted to remove clumps

## Instructions
1. **Brownies:** Melt the butter and mix in the cocoa. Let cool.
2. Add the honey, eggs, sugar, flour, baking powder, and salt. Mix well, then stir in the nuts.
3. Pour into a greased 9x13 pan and bake at 350°F for 25 minutes. Cool completely.
4. **Mint icing:** Soften the butter. Add the salt, corn syrup, and powdered sugar and beat until smooth and fluffy. Mix in the mint extract and food coloring. Add the milk gradually until it's a little thinner than cake frosting.
5. **Chocolate icing:** Soften the butter. Add the salt, corn syrup, powdered sugar, and cocoa and beat until smooth and fluffy. Add the milk gradually until it's a little thinner than cake frosting.
6. Spread the mint icing over the cooled brownies. Pop the pan in the freezer for a short time to firm up the icing.
7. Carefully spread the chocolate icing over the top. Enjoy!

## Notes
From BYU Magazine (Fall 2003), the recipe from Sugar-n-Spice in the Cougareat food court. Makes one 9x13 pan. Allow about 1 hour to cool before icing.

## Tips
- Skip the walnuts if you want them nut-free; the icing layers are the star anyway.

meals.title: Calzone or Pizza Dough
meals.description: Honey-sweetened homemade dough for four calzones or one large pizza.

walmart.name: Great Value Active Dry Yeast, 0.25 oz, 3 Count

Great Value Original Pepperoni Slices, 6 oz

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 1/2 cup lukewarm water
- 1 package (0.25 oz) active dry yeast
- 1/2 cup water
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 2 tbsp honey
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 3 cups all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting
- Your favorite fillings or toppings

## Instructions
1. Mix the 1/2 cup lukewarm water and the yeast in a small bowl. Let stand until foamy, about 5 minutes.
2. In a large bowl, combine the other 1/2 cup water, olive oil, honey, and salt. Add 1 cup flour and mix well.
3. Mix in the yeast mixture, then add the remaining flour 1 cup at a time until the dough is well combined.
4. Knead on a floured surface until soft, smooth, and elastic, about 8 minutes.
5. Roll into 4 calzones or 1 large pizza.
6. Preheat the oven to 400°F. Fill or top the dough, then bake until the crust is lightly browned, 15–20 minutes.

## Tips
- Brush the crust with olive oil and sprinkle with garlic powder.

meals.title: Canned Peaches
meals.description: Bottled peach halves in light syrup, closed-kettle cold pack.

walmart.name: Great Value Pure Granulated Sugar, 4 lb

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- Fresh peaches
- ¾ cup sugar per batch of syrup
- 1 ½ cups hot water per batch of syrup

## Instructions
1. Cut the peaches in half and peel the skins with a knife.
2. Put them in the bottle with the round side of the peach up and the hollow toward the bottom of the jar.
3. Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and pour it over the peaches.
4. Make sure the rim of each bottle is clean, then put on the lid and ring and set it on the rack in the canner.
5. Fill the canner with water to just below the jar rings (don't cover the bottles).
6. Bring to a boil on high, then turn to medium and boil 20 minutes.
7. Turn off the heat, take the lid off the canner, and tighten the rings.
8. Set the bottles out and say a prayer that they seal.

## Notes
These are Grandma's own instructions. For current tested canning times, check the USDA or your local extension office.

From "Cook Like Kathleen," Grandma Kathleen Moessing's family cookbook.

2. Peel, put in another pot, and add the salt and sugar.
3. Bring to a simmering boil for 30 minutes. For tomato sauce, cook longer until it's thick.
4. If you see seeds, smooth it with a stick blender.

These are Grandma's own instructions. For current tested canning methods, check the USDA or your local extension office.

Great Value Pure Granulated Sugar, 4 lb

- 1 cup sugar
- 1 egg

- ½ cup sour cream

1. Heat the oven to 400°F.
2. Beat the sugar, egg, vanilla, butter, and sour cream for 2 minutes.
3. Add the dry ingredients.
4. Roll out ¼ inch thick and cut into shapes.
5. Bake on a buttered cookie sheet 5–6 minutes.

From "Cook Like Kathleen," Grandma Kathleen Moessing's family cookbook.

meals.title: Charlene's Whole Wheat Bread
meals.description: Honey whole wheat bread: a big batch of 4 loaves.

walmart.name: Great Value Active Dry Yeast, 0.25 oz, 3 Count
Great Value Honey, 12 oz
Great Value Vegetable Oil, 48 fl oz

meals.body:
## Ingredients
**Sponge**
- ⅓ cup warm water
- 1 tsp sugar
- 2 tbsp + 2 tsp yeast, rounded

**Dough**
- 5 cups warm water
- 1 tbsp + 1 tsp salt, rounded
- 1 cup honey
- 1 cup vegetable oil
- 9 ⅔ cups white flour
- 5 cups whole wheat flour

## Instructions
1. Mix the warm water, sugar, and yeast and let it stand until foamy.
2. In a large bowl, mix the warm water, salt, honey, and oil. Add the yeast mixture, then the flours, and knead into a smooth dough.
3. Let rise until doubled, then divide into 4 greased loaf pans and let rise again, about 1 hour.
4. Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

## Variations
- Substitute 2 cups rye for part of the 5 cups whole wheat.

## Notes
The original card lists the ingredients and "Bake 350 for 30 min." The mixing and rising steps follow Grandma's [Whole Wheat Bread](#whole-wheat-bread).

From "Cook Like Kathleen," Grandma Kathleen Moessing's family cookbook.

meals.title: Cheese Bread

- 1 cup cooked, shredded chicken (drained canned chicken works great)
- 1 package (8 oz) cream cheese
- 2 tbsp butter
- 1 can (8 oz) Pillsbury crescent rolls

## Instructions
1. Preheat the oven according to the crescent roll package.
2. Mix together the chicken, cream cheese, and butter.
3. Open the can and separate the crescents. Spread each one open into a triangle (easier if the dough sits out of the fridge for a few minutes).

meals.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
meals.description: Slow-simmered chicken soup with carrots, celery, and Grandma's homemade noodles.

Baby Peeled Carrots, 1 lb
Yellow Onion, Each
Great Value All-Purpose Flour, 5 lb
Fresh Celery Stalk, Each
Great Value Chicken Bouillon Powder, 3.75 oz

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 6 chicken breasts (bone-in, skin-on)
- 3 carrots, diced
- 3 stalks celery, diced
- 1 whole onion, diced
- 1 batch [Homemade Noodles](#homemade-noodles)
- Flour, for tossing the noodles

**If using boneless, skinless chicken breasts, also add:**
- 1 tsp salt
- 2 tsp chicken bouillon

## Instructions
1. Bring the chicken to a boil in a large pot of water, then simmer for 2 hours, or until the meat falls off the bone.
2. Remove the chicken. When cool, skin and debone it.
3. Dice the carrots, celery, and onion and add them to the simmering broth.
4. Add the chicken back to the pot and bring to a boil if it isn't already.
5. Toss the homemade noodles with flour and add them to the pot. Cook 5 minutes or less.

## Variations
- **Boneless, skinless breasts:** boil the breasts with the onion, celery, carrot, salt, and bouillon. When the chicken is cooked, remove and shred it while the veggies keep boiling, then return it to the pot and continue with step 5.

## Notes
From "Cook Like Kathleen," Grandma Kathleen Moessing's family cookbook.

Betty Crocker Bisquick Original, 20 oz
Great Value Whole Vitamin D Milk, Gallon
Great Value White Large Eggs, 12 Count

## Ingredients
- 1 bag frozen mixed vegetables, thawed
- 1 cup cut-up cooked chicken
- 1 can (10.75 oz) condensed cream of chicken soup
- 1 cup Original Bisquick mix
- 1/2 cup milk
- 1 egg

## Instructions
1. Preheat the oven to 400°F.
2. In an ungreased 9-inch glass pie plate, stir together the vegetables, chicken, and soup.
3. In a small bowl, stir the Bisquick, milk, and egg with a fork until blended. Pour over the chicken mixture.
4. Bake about 30 minutes, until golden brown.

## Variations
- **Big batch (9x13), ingredients:** 2–3 cans cooked chicken, 2 cans cream of chicken soup, 1 package frozen vegetables, 2 cups Bisquick, and 1 1/2 cups milk (no egg).
- **Big batch, directions:** Mix the chicken, soup, and vegetables in an ungreased 9x13 glass dish. Stir the Bisquick and milk until blended and pour over the top. Bake at 400°F for 40–45 minutes, until a knife comes out clean and the top is a little golden. For the cart, add 1 or 2 more cans of chicken and 1 more can of soup.
- **Freeze half:** Split the big batch between two 8x8 baking dishes and freeze one for later.

## Notes
The original card's directions were accidentally copied from the enchilada recipe, so these steps follow the Allrecipes "Impossibly Easy Chicken Pot Pie" the card links to.

Great Value Frozen Broccoli Florets, 12 oz
Great Value Extra Virgin Olive Oil, 17 fl oz

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 12–15 oz sausage links (breakfast pork links or chicken apple sausage)
- 1 sweet potato, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
- 1 bag (12 oz) frozen broccoli florets, or 1 head fresh broccoli
- 3 tbsp olive oil
- Salt and pepper to taste

## Instructions
1. Heat the oven to 425°F and line a sheet pan with parchment paper.
2. Slice the sausage into 1/2-inch rounds. Cut fresh broccoli, if using, into florets.
3. Put the sausage, sweet potato, and broccoli on the pan. Toss with the olive oil, salt, and pepper, then spread in a single layer.
4. Bake 30–40 minutes, tossing halfway through, until everything is browned and the sausage is done (160°F for raw pork).

## Notes
The original recipe uses 15 oz of fully cooked chicken apple sausage. The shopping list uses breakfast pork sausage links instead.

meals.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
meals.description: Classic chewy chocolate chip cookies with dark brown sugar, baked low and slow.

walmart.name: Great Value Sweet Cream Salted Butter, 16 oz, 4 Sticks
C&H Pure Cane Dark Brown Sugar, 2 lb
Great Value Pure Granulated Sugar, 4 lb
Great Value White Large Eggs, 12 Count
Great Value Pure Vanilla Extract, 1 fl oz
Great Value All-Purpose Flour, 5 lb
Great Value Baking Soda, 1 lb
Great Value Semi-Sweet Chocolate Chips, 12 oz

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 2 sticks butter, softened to room temperature
- 1 cup dark brown sugar
- 3/4 cup granulated sugar
- 2 eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla
- 3 cups flour
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 2 cups chocolate chips

## Instructions
1. Preheat the oven to 300°F.
2. With a mixer, beat the butter, dark brown sugar, and granulated sugar until well mixed.
3. Mix in the eggs and vanilla.
4. Add the flour, baking soda, and salt and mix.
5. Stir in the chocolate chips.
6. Bake about 15 minutes, until the cookies are light brown.
7. Let them sit on the cookie sheet a few extra minutes before moving them to a cooling rack.

## Tips
- Cookies turn out better if each batch goes onto a somewhat cool cookie sheet.

meals.description: Pecan pie with melted chocolate, baked low and slow.

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- ½ cup sugar
- 1 cup dark corn syrup
- ¼ tsp salt
- 1 tbsp all-purpose flour
- 2 eggs
- 1 tbsp butter or margarine
- 2 oz (2 squares) unsweetened chocolate
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 ¼ cups pecan halves
- Pastry for a 1-crust 9-inch pie, unbaked
- Vanilla ice cream, for serving

## Instructions
1. Preheat the oven to 300°F.
2. Beat together the sugar, syrup, salt, flour, and eggs.
3. Melt the butter and chocolate together in the microwave. Add it, the vanilla, and the pecans to the first mixture.
4. Pour into the pastry-lined pie pan.
5. Bake 50–60 minutes, until the filling is just set. Cool.
6. Serve with ice cream, or whipped cream if you prefer.

## Tips
- This pie can be baked a day ahead.

## Notes
From "Cook Like Kathleen," Grandma Kathleen Moessing's family cookbook.

## Ingredients
- 1 cube margarine
- 1 tsp vanilla
- 30 large marshmallows (or 3 cups mini marshmallows)
- 1 ½ tsp green food coloring
- 4 ½ cups corn flakes
- Red hot candies, for berries

## Instructions
1. Melt the margarine and marshmallows over low heat, stirring until smooth.
2. Stir in the vanilla and green food coloring, then the corn flakes, until coated.

meals.title: Creamy Baked Meatballs
meals.description: An old prize-winning recipe card for tender meatballs baked in a creamy mushroom and chicken sauce.

73% Lean Ground Beef, 1 lb Roll (Frozen)

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 4 slices bread
- 1/2 cup milk
- 2 eggs, beaten
- 1/4 tsp pepper
- 2 tbsp minced onion
- 2 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp Accent (MSG)
- 1 1/2 lb ground beef
- 1 can cream of mushroom soup
- 1 can cream of chicken soup
- 1 soup can of milk

## Instructions
1. Soak the bread for 10 minutes in the milk and egg mixture.
2. Combine with all the other ingredients except the soups and the soup can of milk.
3. Shape into 25 meatballs. Brown them in a little fat and place in a baking dish.
4. Mix the undiluted soups with the can of milk and pour over the meatballs.
5. Bake at 325°F for 1 hour.

## Notes
Shared by a friend from my mission.

From a handwritten recipe card marked "A prize winning recipe" ("very similar to Mother's"). The card's title is hard to read, and one smudged line under the ground beef couldn't be made out.

## Tips
- Serve with rice, baked potatoes, or a potato casserole.

meals.title: Crème Brûlée French Toast
meals.description: Overnight Texas-toast French toast on a caramel base, with maple syrup butter.

walmart.name: Great Value Sweet Cream Salted Butter, 16 oz, 4 Sticks
Great Value Light Brown Sugar, 32 oz
Karo Light Corn Syrup, 16 oz
Great Value White Large Eggs, 12 Count
Great Value Pure Vanilla Extract, 1 fl oz
Great Value Thick Sliced Texas Toast, 20 oz
Great Value Half & Half, 32 fl oz
Great Value Pure Maple Syrup, 32 fl oz

meals.body:
## Ingredients
**French toast**
- ½ cup butter
- 1 cup packed brown sugar
- 2 tbsp corn syrup
- 1 loaf Texas toast bread (12 extra-thick slices)
- 5 eggs
- 1 ½ cups half-and-half
- ¼ tsp salt
- 1 tsp vanilla

**Syrup Butter**
- 1 ½ cups butter
- 3 cups maple syrup

## Instructions
1. In a small saucepan, melt the butter, brown sugar, and corn syrup over medium heat until smooth, stirring occasionally.
2. Pour onto a large greased jelly roll pan (18x13x1) and spread to cover.
3. Lay the 12 slices of Texas toast in a single layer over it.
4. Mix the eggs, half-and-half, salt, and vanilla and spoon over each slice.
5. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
6. Bake uncovered at 350°F for about 30 minutes. Remove from the pan and serve. If not serving right away, turn each slice over so it won't stick to the pan.
7. **Syrup butter:** melt the butter and maple syrup together and serve over the toast.

## Notes
From "Cook Like Kathleen," Grandma Kathleen Moessing's family cookbook.

meals.title: Dumplings

Great Value Whole Vitamin D Milk, Gallon

## Ingredients
- 1 ½ cups flour, sifted
- 2 tsp baking powder
- ¾ tsp salt
- ¾ cup milk

## Instructions
1. Stir the flour, baking powder, and salt together.
2. Stir in the milk only until blended.
3. Spoon the dough onto simmering chicken soup or stew to make 6–8 dumplings.
4. Simmer gently, uncovered, for 10 minutes, then cover and cook 10 minutes more. Serve.

## Tips
- Success secret: the dumplings should rest on the chicken and not settle into the liquid.

## Notes
From "Cook Like Kathleen," Grandma Kathleen Moessing's family cookbook.

- 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed

meals.title: Easy White Homemade Bread
meals.description: Soft homemade white bread that makes two loaves or two dozen rolls, stirred with a spoon instead of kneaded.

walmart.name: Great Value Active Dry Yeast, 0.25 oz, 3 Count
Great Value All-Purpose Flour, 5 lb
Great Value Pure Granulated Sugar, 4 lb
Great Value Vegetable Oil, 48 fl oz

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 1/2 cup warm water
- 2 tbsp yeast
- 6 cups flour
- 3 tbsp sugar
- 1 tbsp salt
- 1/3 cup oil
- 2 cups hot water

## Instructions
1. Dissolve the yeast in the warm water.
2. Combine the remaining ingredients using **3 cups of the flour** and beat well.
3. Add the yeast and beat well.
4. Add the remaining flour to make a soft dough that can still be mixed with a spoon (it will be sticky).
5. Leave the spoon in and let the dough rest 10 minutes. Stir it down every 10 minutes, 5 times total.
6. Divide in two. Roll each up like a jelly roll, or make 2 dozen rolls. Place in greased pans.
7. Let rise until doubled, about 30 minutes.
8. Bake at 400°F for 30 minutes.

## Notes
Shared by a friend from my mission.

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 8 eggs
- 1 lb breakfast sausage
- 1/2 bag (16 oz) frozen tater tots
- 1 can (16 oz) jumbo buttermilk biscuits
- 1 avocado, sliced
- Salt and pepper to taste

## Instructions
1. Bake the tater tots and biscuits according to their packages, timing them to finish together.
2. Meanwhile, slice the sausage into patties or crumble it. Cook in a skillet over medium heat until done (160°F). Set aside, leaving a little fat in the pan.
3. Cook the eggs in the same skillet however you like them. Season with salt and pepper.
4. Serve everything with the sliced avocado.

meals.title: Egg Roll in a Bowl
meals.description: All the flavor of an egg roll without the wrapper. Ground turkey and coleslaw mix stir-fried in a sweet, spicy sauce.
meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 1 tbsp avocado oil
- 1 lb ground turkey (or ground beef or pork)
- 1 (16 oz) bag coleslaw mix
- 4 tbsp coconut aminos or soy sauce
- 2 tbsp sriracha, plus more to serve
- 1 tbsp sugar-free honey (or regular honey)
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 1 tsp onion powder
- 1 tsp garlic powder
- 1 tsp ground ginger
- 1/2 tsp chili flakes
- Pinch of salt and pepper
- Green onions and sesame seeds, to top

## Instructions
1. Heat the avocado oil in a large skillet and cook the ground turkey until golden brown. Season with the onion powder, garlic powder, ginger, chili flakes, salt, and pepper.
2. Add the coleslaw mix and let it cook down for 1–2 minutes.
3. Stir in the coconut aminos (or soy sauce), sesame oil, sriracha, and honey.
4. Top with green onions, sesame seeds, and extra sriracha if you like.

## Notes
Use coconut aminos instead of soy sauce to keep it gluten free.

- 1 tsp baking powder
- White fish, like cod

1. Whisk the water, flour, salt, and baking powder into a batter.
2. Pat the fish dry and cut into smaller pieces.

meals.title: Foil-Pack Chicken Fajitas
meals.description: Seasoned rice, chicken, peppers, salsa, and cheese baked in individual foil packets.

walmart.name: Great Value Long Grain Rice, 5 lb

Freshness Guaranteed Thin-Sliced Chicken Breasts, 0.8-3.5 lb
Fresh Green Bell Pepper, Each
Fresh Red Bell Pepper, Each
Great Value Thick and Chunky Medium Salsa, 16 oz
Great Value Finely Shredded Fiesta Blend, 8 oz

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 1 1/2 cups rice
- 1 1/2 cups hot water
- 1 tbsp taco seasoning
- 4 boneless chicken breast halves (about 1 lb)
- 1 green and 1 red bell pepper, sliced
- 1/2 cup salsa
- 1/2 cup shredded cheese

## Instructions
1. Heat the oven to 400°F.
2. Fold up all sides of 4 large sheets of heavy-duty foil to form a 1-inch rim, and spray with cooking spray.
3. Combine the rice, hot water, and taco seasoning and spoon evenly onto the foil. Top with the remaining ingredients.
4. Bring up the foil sides and fold to make 4 packets. Place on a rimmed baking sheet.
5. Bake 30–35 minutes, until the chicken is done (165°F). Cool 5 minutes, then cut slits in the foil to release steam before carefully opening.

## Tips
- Make the packets ahead and refrigerate up to 1 day, then bake as directed.
- Add the liquids last so the packets are easier to fold.
- Go heavier on the taco seasoning.

- 1 loaf (14 oz) French bread
- 10 oz sliced roast beef
- 8 slices Swiss cheese
- 1 packet (1 oz) au jus gravy mix, plus the water called for on the packet

## Instructions
1. Heat the oven to 400°F.
2. Make the au jus according to the packet and keep it warm.
3. Cut the bread into 4 pieces and split each one. Place cut side up on a baking sheet and toast 3–4 minutes.
4. Dip the roast beef in the au jus to warm it, then layer it on the bottom halves and top with the Swiss.
5. Bake 3–4 minutes, until the cheese melts. Add the tops and serve with the au jus for dipping.

- 3 cups mashed peaches
- 3 cups sugar
- Juice from 2 ½ lemons (6 ¼ tbsp)
- Juice from 1 orange
- 1 pint whipping cream
- 1 quart milk
- 1 large can condensed milk

## Instructions
1. Combine the peaches, sugar, lemon juice, and orange juice. Let stand at room temperature for 2–3 hours.
2. Pour into a 4-quart ice cream freezer and add the whipping cream, canned milk, and milk.
3. Freeze!

## Notes
From "Cook Like Kathleen," Grandma Kathleen Moessing's family cookbook.

meals.title: Fruit Cobbler
meals.description: A quart of fruit under a soft, biscuit-style cobbler topping.

meals.body:
## Ingredients
**Fruit**
- 1 quart fruit, with its juice (bottled, or fresh; see step 1)

**Topping**
- 1 ½ cups flour
- 1 ½ tsp baking powder
- ½ cup milk
- 5 tbsp shortening
- 1 tsp sugar
- ¼ tsp salt

## Instructions
1. If using fresh fruit, cook it in a little water with some sugar first: about 1 cup water to 3 cups fruit, brought to a boil.
2. Layer the fruit and juice in the bottom of a greased 8x8 pan.
3. Mix the flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt. Cut in the shortening with a knife or your fingers, then stir in the milk to make a soft dough.
4. Spoon the cobbler mixture over the fruit.
5. Bake for 30 minutes at 350°F.

## Notes
From "Cook Like Kathleen," Grandma Kathleen Moessing's family cookbook.

## Ingredients
- ¾ cup shortening
- 1 egg
- 1 cup sugar
- ¼ cup molasses
- 2 cups flour
- 1 tsp salt
- 2 tsp baking soda
- 1 tsp ginger
- 1 tsp cloves
- 1 tsp cinnamon

## Instructions
1. Heat the oven to 350°F.
2. Cream the shortening and sugar, then beat in the egg and molasses.
3. Stir in the flour, salt, baking soda, ginger, cloves, and cinnamon.
4. Roll into balls and roll in sugar. Bake for 10 minutes.

## Notes
The original card says only "Roll into balls in sugar. Bake 350 F 10 min." The mixing steps are the standard method.

From "Cook Like Kathleen," Grandma Kathleen Moessing's family cookbook.

- 1 lb ground beef or ground turkey
- 1 can black beans (or kidney beans)
- 1 can diced tomatoes
- 1 can tomato sauce
- 1–2 tbsp dehydrated onions (optional)
- Salt and pepper to taste

## Instructions
1. Cook the beef in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned.
2. Add the remaining ingredients and heat until bubbling.
3. Serve right away, or cover, reduce the heat, and simmer for up to 1 hour.

- Serve in bowls, on baked potatoes, on a bed of lettuce, or over tortilla chips.
- Top with cheese, sour cream, lettuce, tomato, and more.

meals.title: Ground Beef Enchiladas
meals.description: Seasoned beef and salsa rolled in corn tortillas and baked in enchilada sauce.

Mission Super Soft Flour Tortillas, Soft Taco Size, 10 Count

Great Value Finely Shredded Fiesta Blend, 8 oz

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 1 lb ground beef
- 1/2 onion, chopped
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 tsp pepper
- 1 cup salsa
- 1 tbsp chili powder
- 1 tsp paprika
- 1 tsp cumin
- 2 cans (10 oz) enchilada sauce (red or green)
- Corn tortillas
- Shredded cheese

## Instructions
1. Preheat the oven to 350°F.
2. In a large skillet, brown the ground beef with the onion. Season with salt, pepper, chili powder, paprika, and cumin. Stir in the salsa.
3. Simmer over low heat for about 10 minutes so the flavors combine.
4. Pour a little enchilada sauce over the bottom of a 9x13 baking pan.
5. Warm the rest of the sauce in a saucepan, then dip each tortilla in it.
6. Spoon meat mixture into each tortilla, roll it up, and place seam-side down in the pan. Repeat until the meat is gone.
7. Pour the remaining sauce over the enchiladas and top with cheese.
8. Bake for 10 minutes, until heated through.

meals.title: Homemade Noodles

- 1 beaten egg
- 2 tbsp milk (in each half of the egg shell)
- ½ tsp salt
- About 1 cup flour (enough for a stiff dough)

From "Cook Like Kathleen," Grandma Kathleen Moessing's family cookbook.

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- ½ bushel ripe tomatoes (25 lbs)
- 1 head of celery, leaves and stalks
- ¼ cup salt (plain, non-iodized)
- ¾ lb butter
- 6 green peppers (4 ½ cups)
- 6 onions (4 ½ cups)
- 1 cup flour (or ¾ cup)
- 1 cup sugar (or 1 ½ cups, to taste)

## Instructions
1. Put the peppers, onions, and celery through a food chopper and cook in a small amount of water until tender.
2. Cook the tomatoes, then remove the skins and strain.
3. Add the cooked vegetables to the tomatoes.
4. Combine the flour and butter, blend with a little hot soup, then add it to the rest of the soup. Stir until well blended.
5. Add the salt and sugar. Simmer for 2–3 hours, then boil 10–12 minutes and bottle.

## Notes
Kathleen's note: simmer for 2–3 hours before placing in bottles. Makes 12 quarts.

From "Cook Like Kathleen," Grandma Kathleen Moessing's family cookbook.

meals.title: Instant Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 2 tbsp oil
- 2 tsp minced garlic
- 8 oz mushrooms
- 2 chicken breasts, cut into 1/2" pieces
- 1 can chicken stock
- 1 cup milk, half & half, or cream
- 1 lb pasta
- 8 oz cream cheese
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Parmesan cheese, for serving

## Instructions
1. Turn the Instant Pot to the **Sauté** setting.
2. Cook the garlic in the oil for 1 minute, then add the mushrooms. Cook about 3 minutes, stirring now and then.
3. Add the chicken, broth, milk, and pasta. Stir.
4. Push **Cancel**.
5. Close and lock the lid, push **Pressure Cook**, and cook on high for 7 minutes.
6. Release the pressure and remove the lid.
7. Stir in the cream cheese.
8. Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve with parmesan.

meals.description: Soft peanut butter cookies with the classic fork crisscross.

Jif Creamy Peanut Butter, 16 oz

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- ¾ cup Jif creamy peanut butter
- ½ stick Crisco all-vegetable shortening
- 1 ¼ cups firmly packed brown sugar
- 3 tbsp milk
- 1 tbsp vanilla extract
- 1 large egg
- 1 ¾ cups all-purpose flour
- ¾ tsp baking soda
- ¾ tsp salt

## Instructions
1. Heat the oven to 375°F.
2. Combine the peanut butter, shortening, brown sugar, milk, and vanilla in a large bowl. Beat at medium speed until well blended. Add the egg and beat just until blended.
3. Combine the flour, baking soda, and salt. Add to the creamed mixture at low speed and mix just until blended.
4. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls 2 inches apart onto a greased baking sheet. Flatten slightly in a crisscross pattern with the tines of a fork.
5. Bake one sheet at a time for 7–8 minutes, until set and just beginning to brown. Cool 2 minutes on the sheet, then move to racks.

## Notes
From "Cook Like Kathleen," Grandma Kathleen Moessing's family cookbook.

meals.title: Kathleen's Baklava
meals.description: Layers of buttered filo and cinnamon walnuts soaked in lemon syrup.

walmart.name: Great Value Sweet Cream Salted Butter, 16 oz, 4 Sticks
Great Value Pure Granulated Sugar, 4 lb
Great Value Ground Cinnamon, 2.5 oz
Great Value Chopped Walnuts, 4 oz
Karo Light Corn Syrup, 16 oz
Fresh Lemon, Each
Athens Phyllo Dough Pastry Sheets, 16 oz (Frozen)

meals.body:
## Ingredients
**Baklava**
- 1 lb filo
- 1 lb butter (no substitutes), melted
- 1 cup sugar
- 2 tsp cinnamon
- 16 oz walnuts

**Syrup** (make before starting the baklava)
- 2 cups sugar
- 1 cup water
- ½ cup light Karo syrup
- Juice from ½ lemon (1 tbsp)

## Instructions
1. **Syrup first:** bring the sugar, water, Karo, and lemon juice to a boil. Simmer 20–25 minutes, watching so it doesn't burn. Let it cool.
2. Heat the oven to 350°F. Chop or grind the walnuts very fine and mix with the sugar and cinnamon.

meals.title: No-Knead Artisan Bread
meals.description: Crusty Dutch oven bread from four ingredients. Stir it together at night and bake it the next day, with no kneading.
meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 390 g (3 cups) bread flour (not all-purpose), plus more for dusting
- 1/4 tsp instant yeast
- 1 1/4 tsp fine sea salt
- 320 g (about 1 1/3 cups) water

## Instructions
1. In a large bowl, stir together the flour, yeast, salt, and water until a rough dough forms. If it seems very dry, add a little more water.
2. Move the dough to an oiled container and cover loosely with plastic wrap. Let it rise at room temperature (about 70°F) for 14 hours or overnight, until puffed up to about 1 1/2 to 2 times its size.
3. Lightly flour a sheet of parchment paper and set the dough on it. Fold the dough in half, then in half again.
4. Shape it into a ball by tucking the sides underneath, and set it seam side down on the parchment. Cover and let it rest until puffy but not fully risen, 30 minutes to 2 hours depending on how warm your kitchen is.
5. Preheat the oven to 500°F with a 6-quart Dutch oven inside for 20 minutes. Take the pot out, slide your hand under the parchment, and flip the dough into the pot so the seam faces up. Cover with the lid.
6. Put the pot in the oven and lower the temperature to 400°F. Bake covered for 40 minutes, then uncover and bake 15–20 minutes more, until golden brown.
7. Check that it's cooked through: tip the loaf on its side and push a thermometer into the bottom. It should read 200–205°F. If not, put it back in (extra time is fine; put the lid back on if the top is browning too fast).
8. Cool on a wire rack for at least 1 hour. It should feel light and sound hollow when you knock on the bottom. Cutting it too soon makes the crumb gummy.

## Notes
Plan ahead: the dough needs about 14 hours to rise, plus up to 2 more hours after shaping. Mix it after dinner and bake the next day.

Adapted by The Clever Carrot from Jim Lahey's no-knead bread.

## Tips
- If the dough isn't puffy and bubbly after the first rise, put it in the microwave with the light on and the door cracked. The warmth from the bulb gives the yeast a boost in a chilly kitchen.

meals.body:
## Ingredients
**Yeast mixture**
- 1 package yeast
- ¼ cup warm water
- 1 tsp sugar

**Dry ingredients**
- 3 ½ cups flour
- ¼ cup sugar
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 stick butter

**Liquids**
- 1 cup heavy cream (or evaporated milk)
- ¼ cup evaporated milk
- 3 egg yolks

## Instructions
1. Mix the yeast, warm water, and sugar and let stand.
2. Cut the butter into the dry ingredients as for pie crust.
3. Mix the cream, evaporated milk, and egg yolks.
4. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients. Pour in the yeast mixture and liquids and stir until moist.
5. Put in a large bowl, spread butter or Crisco over the top, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate overnight.
6. Two hours before baking, take the dough out and knead to work the butter in.
7. Cut the dough in half. Roll each half into a big circle no thinner than ¼ inch and cut into about 12 wedges.
8. Roll up from the fat end to the point, like crescent rolls. Put on a parchment-lined cookie sheet.
9. Brush with melted butter, cover, and let rise 2 hours.
10. Bake at 350°F for 12 minutes.

## Notes
From "Cook Like Kathleen," Grandma Kathleen Moessing's family cookbook.

## Ingredients
- 2 lbs round steak
- 2 tbsp salad (vegetable) oil
- Water
- ⅓ cup soy sauce
- 2 tsp sugar
- ¼ tsp pepper
- 1 clove garlic, minced
- 3 carrots, peeled
- 2 green peppers, cut
- ½ lb mushrooms
- 1 can (8 oz) water chestnuts
- 2 tbsp cornstarch
- ¼ cup water

## Instructions
1. Cut the steak into strips ⅛ inch thick. Brown the strips in hot oil.
2. Pour off the drippings, measure, and add water to make 1 cup. Combine with the soy sauce, sugar, pepper, and garlic and add to the meat.
3. Cover and cook slowly for 40 minutes.
4. Meanwhile, cut the carrots lengthwise into thin strips with a vegetable peeler, then cut them in half.
5. Add the carrots, peppers, mushrooms, and water chestnuts to the meat. Cover and cook 15 minutes more.
6. Combine the cornstarch and ¼ cup water and stir in to thicken the sauce.

## Notes
The original steps also mention scallions, which aren't in the ingredient list. Add a few if you have them.

meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 1 lb Italian sausage (mild or spicy)
- 1/8 onion, chopped
- 1/2 tsp dried oregano
- 1/2 tsp dried basil
- 1 tbsp dried parsley
- 2 cloves garlic (or 2 tsp garlic salt or garlic powder)
- 1/2 cup carrots, sliced and cooked (unless you're simmering a long time, then they'll cook in the soup)
- 1 zucchini, grated
- 1 can (14–15 oz) diced tomatoes (petite diced preferred, regular is fine)
- 1 small can (8 oz) tomato sauce
- 1/2 cup apple juice
- 1/2 cup water
- 4 cans (14–15 oz each, about 60 oz total) chicken broth
- 1 lb tortellini (frozen, fresh, or dried)

## Instructions
1. Brown the sausage in a large soup pot with the onion and spices.
2. While it browns, slice and cook the carrots and grate the zucchini.
3. Once the sausage is browned, add everything else to the pot and heat through.
4. Serve, or keep it on a simmer (or in a crock pot) for hours. If simmering a while, make sure the carrots and any dried tortellini are soft before serving.

## Notes
Shared by a friend from my mission.

With frozen or fresh tortellini and pre-cooked carrots, this soup is done in about 20 minutes.

## Tips
- Using dried tortellini? Let it simmer a long time, or cook it before adding.

## Variations
- Add, swap, or leave out veggies however you like.
- Add extra water or broth if you want it brothier.

## Ingredients
- 1 lb pork sausage
- 1 can (15.5 oz) chili beans, undrained
- 1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes, undrained
- 1 bag (12 oz) frozen mixed vegetables
- Salt and pepper to taste
- 1 box (8.5 oz) honey corn muffin mix, plus the egg and milk called for on the box

## Instructions
1. Make the corn bread according to the box and put it in the oven.
2. Brown the sausage in a large pot over medium-high heat, breaking it up, until cooked through. Drain the fat.
3. Stir in the chili beans, diced tomatoes, and frozen vegetables.
4. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer 10–15 minutes, until the vegetables are tender. Season with salt and pepper.
5. Serve with the corn bread.

## Ingredients
- ¾ stick Crisco butter-flavor shortening
- 1 ¼ cups firmly packed light brown sugar
- 2 tbsp milk
- 1 tbsp vanilla extract
- 1 large egg
- 1 ¾ cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp salt
- ¾ tsp baking soda
- 1 package (6 oz) semi-sweet chocolate chips (1 cup)
- 1 cup coarsely chopped pecans (optional)

## Instructions
1. Heat the oven to 375°F.
2. Beat the shortening and brown sugar in a large bowl at medium speed until light and fluffy. Beat in the milk, vanilla, and egg.
3. Stir in the flour, salt, and baking soda. Blend in the chocolate chips and nuts.
4. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets.
5. Bake 8–10 minutes for chewy cookies or 11–13 minutes for crisp ones. Cool 2 minutes on the sheet, then move to a rack.

## Tips
- If you leave out the nuts, add another ½ cup semi-sweet chocolate chips.

## Notes
The original says "2 t milk," likely 2 tablespoons (Crisco's printed version of this recipe uses 2 tbsp).

- ¾ stick Crisco baking sticks (or ¾ cup Crisco all-vegetable shortening)

- ¾ cup firmly packed brown sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 2 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp baking soda

1. Heat the oven to 375°F. Lightly coat baking sheets with cooking spray.

meals.body:
## Ingredients
**Sweet Potatoes**
- 4 cups peeled, cubed sweet potatoes (about 2 ½ lbs whole)
- 2 large eggs, beaten
- ½ cup sugar
- ½ cup milk
- 4 tbsp butter, softened
- ½ tsp vanilla
- ½ tsp salt

**Pecan Topping**
- ½ cup packed brown sugar
- ⅓ cup flour
- 3 tbsp butter, softened
- ½ cup chopped pecans

## Instructions
1. Heat the oven to 325°F.
2. Cover the sweet potatoes with water in a saucepan and boil until fork-tender, 10–15 minutes. Drain.
3. Mash the sweet potatoes, then mix in the eggs. Add the sugar, milk, butter, vanilla, and salt and mix until smooth. Spread in a 9x13 baking dish.
4. Mix the brown sugar and flour, then cut in the butter until it looks like coarse crumbs. Stir in the pecans and sprinkle over the sweet potatoes.
5. Bake about 30 minutes, until the topping is lightly browned.

## Tips
- Make it up to 2 days ahead: refrigerate the filling and topping separately, then top and bake (add a few minutes if it's cold).
- Leftovers keep 3–4 days. Reheat covered at 350°F for 20–25 minutes.
- Several reviewers say the filling is thin in a 9x13; use more sweet potatoes or an 8x8 pan if you want it thicker.
